license.scope: benchmark repository; third-party source repository snapshots remain under original project licenses

assets.role: positive references; full content acquisition must be verified before import
negative discussion/reference records; not automatically clean code-change negatives
pinned dataset methodology, schema and annotation description

knownLimitations: The dataset is a comment-level benchmark: 196 positive PR records contain 1,506 expert-annotated positive reference comments; 155 negative PR records contain 639 expert-annotated incorrect reference comments. Negative comments are false-positive references, not clean-negative code-change PRs.

The upstream README states reference comments combine original review discussions and model-generated feedback followed by expert annotation; preserve is_ai_comment and source_model instead of treating AI-generated comments as human-originated.

The positive reference asset includes 1,506 nested comments with file paths and line ranges, but one positive comment has a reversed range (from_line 1153, to_line 1144) and must be quarantined; do not silently normalize it.
The negative reference asset has 639 nested comments with file paths and line ranges; all 639 ranges pass the bounded range check. Its PR-level rows have no top-level file/path field.
Do not import a positive or negative label into Safe Core until the AACR-to-Safe category/severity/scope crosswalk and per-project source license review are approved.
The positive and negative assets contain model-generated comments as well as human-originated comments; retain is_ai_comment and source_model for stratified evaluation.
Original third-party project licenses must be checked per source snapshot.

snapshot.note: Source and Apache-2.0 license are registered; large positive/negative JSON snapshots were not imported or used for model evaluation.

positiveAssetAcquisition.note: Pinned asset retrieved and structurally inspected. No comments or source code were imported; one reversed line range is quarantined.
